intent_snapshot.goal: Rename the eight packaged Immune-Brain skills to the bare verbs of #318 (clarify, draw-up, drive, revisit, slim, prune-docs, prune-tests, fix-pr) and make the run-entry gate on both Hosts recognize only the new names under the 2026-10-28 rules, with the current documentation surface, ADR 0031, a major changeset and CONTEXT.md mapping aligned; dated history stays unedited. Technical design: docs/specs/skill-rename-bare-verbs.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Per #318 Decisions and G-D2 (docs/specs/skill-rename-bare-verbs.spec.md D2): the run-entry gate recognizes only the new names, through the Host input hooks on both Hosts. Positive: /drive, /immune-brain:drive, /skill:drive, /clarify, /draw-up and an alias whose body contains /drive enter their phase and a run entry mints a token. Negative: /imm-run, /imm-loop, alias bodies naming imm-run or imm-loop, an alias body 'drive the build', /driver, an alias body with two distinct marked phase mentions, a same-named user or project skill for bare /drive (Claude Code and Pi) and for /skill:drive on Pi, and a throwing skill reader all enter nothing and mint no token. Bound: a same-named user command is parsed by alias rules, and /immune-brain:drive still mints on Claude Code when a same-named user skill exists. Agreed seams: tests/phase-entry.test.ts, tests/claude-phase-entry-gate.test.ts, tests/claude-phase-entry-skill-gate.test.ts, tests/pi-phase-entry-gate.test.ts.

Per the #318 mapping and docs/specs/skill-rename-bare-verbs.spec.md D1: the eight skills live under their new directory and dist names with matching frontmatter name, H1 'Immune-Brain: <Verb>', registry title and next_actions, and dist/drive-batch.md replaces dist/imm-run-batch.md; dist sync shows zero drift. Negative: any surviving old skill directory or old dist file, or an H1, title or next_actions entry that disagrees with the new name, fails. Agreed seams: plugins/immune-brain/tests/skill-registry-consistency.test.ts, tests/skill-registry-metadata-contract.test.ts, tests/skill-dist-consistency.test.ts, scripts/sync-dist-docs.ts --check.

Per #318 Verification (revised) and G-D1 (docs/specs/skill-rename-bare-verbs.spec.md D4): a scan in tests/skill-dist-consistency.test.ts finds zero word-bounded old skill names (the eight old names and imm-loop) in plugins/immune-brain/** except plugins/immune-brain/tests/**, root README.md, CONTEXT.md (outside its delimited mapping table), AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/**, docs/reference/**, docs/user_manual.md and scripts/** except scripts/stale-reference-baseline.json. Negative: the scan helper reports a seeded imm-run in a sample. Bound: imm-plan, imm-kernel and imm-canary-work are not matches, and the stale-reference ratchet stays within its raised baseline. Agreed seams: tests/skill-dist-consistency.test.ts, tests/stale-reference-ratchet.test.ts.

Per repository evidence (docs/agents/derived-files.json, docs/specs/skill-rename-bare-verbs.spec.md reference closure): the checked-in Claude bundle matches a fresh generate after the runtime rename, and both Host packages load the renamed skills. Negative: a stale mcp-server.mjs or a packed Pi loader still resolving an old skill path fails. Agreed seams: scripts/build-claude-plugin.ts --check, tests/claude-host-package.test.ts, tests/pi-canary-packed-loader.test.ts.

Per #318 Decisions (docs/specs/skill-rename-bare-verbs.spec.md D3, D5): docs/adr/0031-*.md records the rename and names ADR 0025 as the recognition part it amends; .changeset/skill-rename-bare-verbs.md is a major immune-brain changeset whose breaking note names /immune-brain:drive and Pi /reload; CONTEXT.md carries the delimited old-to-new mapping table; the skills guide checklist includes the local user skill or command check. Negative: a missing ADR, a non-major changeset, or a note lacking either entry form fails. Agreed seam: shell checks over those files.

Per #318 Verification (revised) (docs/specs/skill-rename-bare-verbs.spec.md D4): dated history stays unedited. Negative: any change since 5a0d9a1 to an accepted ADR, to docs/plans or docs/specs other than this intent and Spec, to docs/reports, docs/solutions, docs/brainstorms, docs/evidence, docs/archives, docs/proposals, benchmark-results or CHANGELOG.md, or a modified or deleted existing changeset fails. Bound: the new ADR 0031, this intent, this Spec and the new changeset are allowed. Agreed seam: git diff against the pinned base.

findings.summary: A same-named local command that exists but that readAliasFile reports as null or empty is treated as absent, so a bare /drive still mints a run entry token. This breaks the AC1 rule that a same-named user command is parsed by alias rules, and the ADR 0031 rule that a reader that cannot read fails closed.

evidence.trigger: Setup: ~/.claude/commands/drive.md (or .claude/commands/drive.md, or Pi .pi/prompts/drive.md) exists but is empty, larger than MAX_ALIAS_BYTES (64 KiB), not a regular file, or unreadable (EACCES). readAliasFile returns null or an empty string for all of these. recognizePhaseEntry checks `if (body)`, which is false, and falls through to packaged('drive') with no local skill. Result: the Host runs the user's own drive command, but the hook records a run entry and mints the entry token (a probe of the review-commit phase_entry.ts returned 'run' for both alias:()=>'' and alias:()=>null). That token admits enroll, start_unattended_batch and retire_stale_batch without a real drive entry. Fix: the alias port should tell a clean ENOENT apart from present-but-unreadable or empty, and the bare form should mint nothing in the second case, the same way localSkillExists fails closed. Add a test that pins an empty and an oversized same-named drive.md with no token minted.
